decision_rule.no_transportable_candidate_signal: Pooled C2 RMSE is not lower than C1 RMSE.
decision_rule.positive_but_not_material: Pooled C2 improvement is positive but at least one material gate fails.

estimation.alpha_selection: Leave-one-region-out CV on 2011_TO_2016 separately for C1 and C2; lowest centered-residual RMSE, ties favor stronger regularization.
estimation.coefficient_transport: Apply 2016-selected alpha and coefficients unchanged to 2021 after permitted pre-election feature centering.

estimand.interpretation: Territorial redistribution conditional on the observed national party swing; this is an oracle-national-swing retrospective diagnostic, not an operational forecast.
estimand.target: raw_change minus the within-transition, within-party mean raw_change

forbidden: Invoke an LLM in this experiment.
Use 2021 performance to change features, alpha grid, thresholds or party structure after execution.
Claim a seat-level result from vote-share diagnostics.
Treat the old V2 terminal KILL as a valid general candidate-intelligence conclusion.
interpretation_limits: A positive result would justify a new prospective 2026 candidate-layer specification, not modification of F0 today.
A negative result applies only to retained-incumbent information in this PJD/RNI panel and corrected specification.
This run cannot establish causal candidate effects.
This run cannot establish incremental value over F0.

metrics.primary: C2 versus C1 centered-territorial-logit-change RMSE on 2021

C0_SWING_ONLY.meaning: All territories receive the observed party-level swing; no local redistribution model.

C2_CANDIDATE_AUGMENTED.interpretation: Ridge-shrunk global and party-heterogeneous persistence effects; no hand-set party weights.

preprocessing.feature_centering: Within each transition and party using only pre-election prior shares and candidate states.
preprocessing.prediction_constraint: Center predicted territorial residuals to zero within each party so the candidate layer cannot create national swing.

purpose: Determine whether retained-incumbent information improves the transportable territorial redistribution of PJD and RNI support after national party swing and local mean reversion are separated.
